text: Done at 3fa54e52. scalafim.image.world (renamed from image.space: clashed with exported SomeNeuroVolume.space on clean builds; P1.01 code moved with it). WorldSpace {Template, SubjectNative(ns, subject, session, ReferenceAcquisition), SubjectTkRas, Declared(fresh token, label), Unresolved}; GeometryDigest is lossless (raw IEEE bits); percent-encoded persistent ids with decode; FrameCatalog sole creator of RAS-mm D3 world frames. Deviation, recorded: the shared 'scalafim-ras-d3' id is kept as WorldSpace.Unresolved (explicit no-evidence space) so existing workflows and persisted records keep aligning; resolved spaces get distinct ids; SampleSpaces.inWorld relabels unresolved/ephemeral only and refuses cross-world relabels. Tests (WorldSpaceSuite, 9): dataset collisions, two boldrefs, declare fresh, encode/decode incl. specials, independent frames align by key, registry restore, ephemeral rejection, relabel rules.
